requirement.reading: That is simply how the pipeline is functioning right now.

narrator.name: Automation Alex
narrator.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: During the infrastructure sync, {automation_alex} mentioned that the CI/CD pipeline for model deployment is currently broken. The automated build and release steps have stalled, so the team cannot push new model versions through the usual tooling. To keep the nightly forecast running, the engineers are manually copying the trained model artifacts to the serving environment and restarting the containers by hand. This manual workaround is how the weekly retraining cycle currently proceeds. {automation_alex.first} noted that the underlying scripts exist but fail at the final deployment stage, forcing the team to bypass the automated checks entirely to get the new weights live.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state of the CI/CD pipeline and the manual workaround being used, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
